why: Multiple corroborating sources (Terence Tao's blog, GitHub teorth/sendov, ProofAtlas, arXiv 2609.04246) report that Sendov's conjecture was proved, with an AI-generated proof (GPT-5.6 Pro, posted by Lech Mazur on 5 Aug 2026) subsequently verified, digested, and Lean-formalized by Tao, also resolving the stronger Phelps-Rodriguez conjecture.
queries: Sendov conjecture Wikipedia proved Tao Mazur GPT Lean
